_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Holdfast NaW egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Holdfast: Nations at War
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The Napoleonic-era multiplayer shooter of line battles, sieges and naval combat, for up to 150 players. Installs the Linux dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; if [ -n "{{SERVER_PASS}}" ]; then sed -i -E "s/^#?server_password( .*)?\$/server_password {{SERVER_PASS}}/" serverconfig.txt; else sed -i -E "s/^server_password( .*)?\$/#server_password/" serverconfig.txt; fi; exec "./Holdfast NaW" -startserver --serverheadless -batchmode -nographics -screen-width 640 -screen-height 480 -screen-quality Fastest -framerate {{FPSMAX}} -serverConfigFilePath serverconfig.txt -logFile - -logArchivesDirectory logs_archive/ -playersLogFilePath logs/players.txt -adminCommandsLogFilePath logs/adminactions.txt -chatLogFilePath logs/chat.txt -scoreboardLogFilePath logs/scores.txt -vacLogFilePath logs/vac.txt -bannedPlayersFilePath bannedplayers.txt -mutedChatPlayersFilePath muteplayerschat.txt -mutedVoipPlayersFilePath muteplayersvoip.txt -micSpammersPlayersFilePath micspammers.txt

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Holdfast: Nations at War. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app
# 1424230) with SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. serverconfig.txt, ban lists
# and logs are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-1424230}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The server's settings and map rotations live in serverconfig.txt, made from
# the game's example once; updates replace the example, never this file.
# The Panel sets the name, admin password, region, welcome message and ports
# at every start, and the startup sets the password.
cfg=serverconfig.txt
if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then
    grep -v '^#server_password' serverconfig_default.txt > "$cfg"
    echo "Made serverconfig.txt from the game's example."
fi
for key in server_name server_admin_password server_region server_welcome_message server_port steam_query_port; do
    grep -q "^$key " "$cfg" || sed -i "1i $key x" "$cfg"
done
grep -qE '^#?server_password( |$)' "$cfg" || sed -i '1i #server_password' "$cfg"
mkdir -p logs logs_archive
echo "Installed Holdfast: Nations at War build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for logging in as admin in game (F1). No spaces.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for a public server.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: The region the server is listed in.

variables.name: Welcome message
variables.description: The message players get in chat when they join.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
